# Afarinesh High School, Shiraz (دبیرستان غیردولتی آفرینش شیراز)

> Afarinesh High School is a private (non-governmental), research-based boys' lower-secondary school for grades 7, 8 and 9 in Shiraz, Iran, founded in 2008 (1387 in the Iranian calendar). Classes have 15 to 17 students, every subject has a specialist teacher, three counsellors (academic, clinical and nutrition) work in the school, and students choose year-long electives in research, art, languages, culture and sport.

دبیرستان غیردولتی آفرینش شیراز (مدرسه آفرینش) دبیرستانی پسرانه و پژوهش‌محور برای دوره اول متوسطه، پایه‌های هفتم، هشتم و نهم است که از سال ۱۳۸۷ در چنچنه، خیابان نارون، نبش کوچه‌ی ۱۴ شیراز فعالیت می‌کند.

## Key facts

- Name: Afarinesh High School, Shiraz. Also known as Afarinesh School, Afarinesh Private School, دبیرستان آفرینش, مدرسه آفرینش, دبیرستان غیردولتی آفرینش
- Type: private (non-governmental), research-based, boys only, lower-secondary (grades 7 to 9)
- Founded: 2008 (1387)
- Address: Narvan Street, corner of Alley 14, Chenchene, Shiraz, Fars, Iran (شیراز، چنچنه، خیابان نارون، نبش کوچه‌ی ۱۴)
- Phone: +98 71 3229 3194, +98 71 3229 5122
- E-mail: afarineshsch@afarineshshiraz.ir
- Office hours: Saturday to Wednesday, 7:00 to 14:00 (Iran time)
- Class size: 15 to 17 students
- Teaching: maths as two courses (arithmetic and geometry), science as two courses (physics–chemistry and biology–earth science), each with a specialist teacher
- Counselling: academic, clinical and nutrition counsellors in the school
- Assessment: four school-wide exam rounds a year and the school's own practice books
- Electives (run all year, chosen by the student): research (programming, robotics, comic making, aerospace, artificial intelligence), art (drawing, sculpture, graphic design, architecture, khatam marquetry, film), languages (English term courses, French), culture (book reviews, Shahnameh reading, creative writing, research methods, essay writing), sport (futsal, chess)
- Admission: online pre-registration form (Persian), a call from the vice principals, a specialist interview with the student and parents, then the result
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/afarinesh_sch
